::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 139,703 people lived in County Louth, up 8.4% on 2016. It had the 12th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 109% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Louth was €1,433, the 8th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
